title: unidaw 0.1 is out
prompt: Start a new song in ~/music/unidaw-short-intro at 96 BPM. Make two sections: Intro (4 bars) and Verse (8 bars). Add a drum beat with the built-in drum kit and a simple bass line in A minor with the 4OSC synth, both playing through both sections. Then render the song to ~/music/unidaw-short-intro/song.wav.
